heard: A daughter of Levi in Egypt lived, Amram married her, a covenant kept She bore Aaron and Miriam too, Moses came when the decree stood The king commanded to kill the boys But she saw the beauty of the child's face She hid him for three, four months Not afraid of the king's heavy command Fate stood strong in the land When she could hide him no longer She made a basket of papyrus Coated with tar and pitch Laid the child in it gently Set it among the reeds
